text:
Rayman Legends Retold - Game Overview Trailer
Join Elana Dunkelman, the voice of Barbara, for a closer look at Rayman Legends Retold’s new and reimagined content!

With cinematic storytelling, thrilling Dragon Rides, and an all-new realm to explore, get ready for an adventure full of surprises, whether you’re returning to the Glade of Dreams or jumping in for the first time!

Pre-order now: raymanlegendsretold.com

About Rayman Legends Retold:
Embark on a bold reimagining of the critically acclaimed platformer, enhanced with stunning 3D visuals and an immersive new story leading to a mysterious new realm. Play the adventure solo or in up to four‑player couch co‑op, jam through all‑new musical stages, saddle up for epic dragon rides, and more!

text:
The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park Showcase
Join us for the Echoes of Central Park Showcase on September 24 at 9 AM PDT / 6 PM CEST, featuring the World Gameplay Reveal of The Division 2's upcoming DLC, exclusive developer interviews, Twitch Drops, special offers, and announcements about what's next for the game.

Get a closer look at the darkest and most disturbing DLC yet, as Agents venture into Central Park for the first time in franchise history to uncover the truth behind a mysterious new threat.

Broadcast live on YouTube and Twitch (twitch.tv/thedivisiongame).
